description: One platform's games with their prices, most popular first or by price: the most valuable games on a console, the cheapest, A to Z. Optionally only PAL, NTSC or Japanese releases.

currency.description: Currency for prices, an ISO 4217 code: USD (the default), EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY, PLN and others.

limit.description: Games a page, 1 to 60 (20 when left out).

page.description: Page of games; a sort shows the platform's first 180.

platform.description: A platform slug from list_platforms, e.g. "super-nintendo".

region.description: pal, ntsc-u (North America) or ntsc-j (Japan and Asia); every region when left out.

sort.description: most-listed (most popular, the default), name (A to Z), price (highest first), price-asc (lowest first).

name: browse_platform
title: Browse a platform
